name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching V8 Supercars with his dad in Bathurst. After completing his apprenticeship in composite manufacturing, he specialized in motorsport applications, honing his skills in aerodynamics and lightweighting. He landed a role at ProSport Racing two years ago and quickly became a valuable asset, known for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to diagnose and resolve composite failures with speed and precision.

Liam is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible with composite technology. He thrives on the challenge of optimizing every component for maximum performance and reliability. His innovative approach and deep understanding of material properties set him apart. He's always seeking new ways to improve the structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency of the race cars.

He's determined to make a significant impact on the team's success, striving to become a leading expert in composite engineering within motorsport. He brings a rare combination of technical skill, visionary thinking, and genuine passion to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze and a permanent smudge of carbon fiber dust somewhere on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces while deep in thought.
Can identify different types of composite materials by smell alone.
